properties.description: Works to Trees with TPOBOS 2005-14 - T56 & T57 Cherry treesT53 - T54. - T54 Silver Birch, growing in close proximity to the old driveway and double gate. In competition with T53 and the underlying hedge, this tree has become tall and asymmetric.
